substantiveAssessment: Useful diagnosis sequence distinguishes incoming invitations, external subscriptions and ordinary/imported records before destructive actions. Scenario avoids claiming that opening a link necessarily created a subscription.

Provider-specific action descriptions are appropriately separated: Apple Calendar iOS26+ menus, Google iPhone/iPad reporting, Google computer future-invitation settings and iCloud web on tablet/computer. No invented Cloud anti-spam/control capability.
Google reporting eligibility is confined to Google Calendar-sent events. Recurring-series removal is explicit and checked before confirmation; no misleading single-occurrence advice.
Future settings apply to new invitations only, may be administrator-limited, and do not prevent every email. Known-sender definition and contact-disclosure caveat match current docs.
Apple subscription removal is not equated to deleting an owned calendar. Hiding is distinguished from source removal; unsupported all-calendar cleanup or secret-feed reset is not advised.
iCloud cross-device removal is correctly confined to the same Apple Account, with no universal provider/instant-propagation promise.

Checks are narrow, source-aware and usable; seven sections cover different decision points rather than padded synonym paragraphs. Related guides cover outgoing access, feed handling and disconnection; new incoming triage task is coherent.
